n: Jared Carter, who had already served a mission in the East, is called to go again, traveling town to town with the priesthood authority he received at his ordination to share the restored gospel.

f.g: The eastern United States and Canada—“countries” here means regions or districts, not nations.

n: He will not go alone: the Holy Ghost, the Comforter, will teach him what is true and even guide where he should travel next.
If he stays faithful, the Lord will again reward him with converts—pictured as bundles of harvested grain carried home with joy.

f.g: Bundles of harvested grain; here a symbol of the people brought into the gospel through a missionary’s labor.

n: The Savior closes with tender encouragement: be glad and don’t be afraid. The one sending Jared is Jesus Christ himself.
